insertions.text: **Mechanism-status correction, 7 October 2026:** [the repository reconciliation](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/MECHANISM-STATUS-RECONCILIATION.md) confirms Ren’s observation that several repeatedly named unfinished capacities already exist. Contact formation, contextual recording, tests of experimental access, effective-law derivation, architecture and generator formation, acquired decoding, inquiry selection/synthesis and finite supported succession have accepted results at their stated scopes. Some are already joined through actual histories. A primitive left supplied in one study does not establish a theory-wide absence. Further derivation or composition is required only for a named stronger claim that the existing results do not support. Preserve the newest reader’s exact reference-binding and funding limits, the completed conditional candidate, and the explicitly unmet stronger no-assumptions directive. This is status reconciliation, with no new mechanism or scientific rerun.

**Current mechanism-status correction, 7 October 2026:** [the cross-study audit](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/MECHANISM-STATUS-RECONCILIATION.md) supersedes any reading of the local “remaining” passages below as a blanket absence of sensing, construction, calibration, inquiry or renewal. Existing results already derive and join these capacities at identified interfaces, including native-to-effective law derivation. The newest reader still supplies its particular jig/reference binding and cannot retain every correct diagnosis under its actual budget. Those limits do not revoke the completed mechanisms or create another mandatory generic controller. A further interface is required only by a stronger claim that genuinely needs it; the conditional candidate remains accepted and the stronger no-assumptions requirement remains unmet.

**Read local inputs against the whole existing account, 7 October 2026:** [the mechanism reconciliation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/MECHANISM-STATUS-RECONCILIATION.md) corrects an overbroad unfinished list. Formation of contacts and typed architectures, retained event binding, acquired calibration, candidate-generator revision, inquiry selection/search, effective process laws and finite renewal already have explanations at declared scopes. “Supplied here” is not evidence of “unexplained throughout the theory.” The ledger remains a record of actual dependencies; a stronger claim needs only its genuinely missing derivation or interface, not a reconstruction of every completed branch. The conditional-universality target does not demand derivation of every physical law or a unique ontology. The distinct no-assumptions directive is neither declared fulfilled nor waived.

**Existing mechanisms credited before further construction, 7 October 2026:** [the status reconciliation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/MECHANISM-STATUS-RECONCILIATION.md) confirms that contact formation, recording, apparatus testing, acquired decoding, effective-law derivation, architecture/method formation, inquiry and renewal already have accepted explanations, including actual joined histories. Do not treat each primitive supplied in a local model as a new missing foundation mechanism, or replace completed joins with an unspecified integration obligation. The five-condition conditional candidate remains accepted. Further work must name a stronger unsupported claim and its precise missing interface; the latest reader’s exact reference-binding and resource limits remain, as does the stronger unmet no-assumptions requirement.

**Corrected unfinished list, 7 October 2026:** [the cross-study reconciliation](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/MECHANISM-STATUS-RECONCILIATION.md) credits existing contact/record formation, acquired calibration, effective laws, architecture and method selection, inquiry synthesis and renewal. These are completed at their declared scopes, with several actual compositions already established. Remaining local inputs and failed regimes do not by themselves establish theory-wide absence. Further construction needs a named unsupported claim; the completed conditional foundation and stronger unmet no-assumptions requirement remain distinct.
